title: How to Learn Faster with the Feynman Technique
author: Mind Centre
content:
Topic: Critical Mind-focused Learning

The Feynman Technique, named after Nobel Prize-winning physicist Richard Feynman, is one of the most effective ways to truly understand any concept. The method is simple: explain the topic as if teaching it to a child, identify gaps in your explanation, go back to the source material, and simplify your explanation further. At Mind Centre, our Critical Mind-focused Learning methodology encourages students to teach concepts to their peers, reinforcing deep understanding rather than surface-level memorization for PSLE, O-Level, and A-Level success.

title: The Memory Palace: Unlock Your Brain's Hidden Potential
author: Mind Centre
content:
Topic: Story Memory Technique

The Memory Palace technique, also known as the Method of Loci, is one of the most powerful memory strategies ever discovered. This video from Sprouts explains how you can use spatial visualization to remember vast amounts of information. By associating items with specific locations in a familiar place, your brain creates strong neural pathways that make recall almost effortless. Students at Mind Centre use this exact technique to memorize Science concepts, English vocabulary, and Math formulas with remarkable speed.
